note: Saskatchewan's first regional park (1961), on Thomson Lake reservoir about 5 km north of Lafleche off Hwy 58, with a pool, nine-hole golf, beach and marina. Mostly seasonal: about 73 of its roughly 380 sites are sold by the night, in the A and C loops along the shore and the Tuscany loop by the gate, plus 16 unserviced overflow tent sites. --Claude
summary: Keep, with UPGRADE lakeview -> lakefront and a PIN MOVE (~610 m). Regional park: nightly sites 50 A, with water or full hookups; C$50/55 a night, tents C$27; books on Let's Camp. About 73 nightly electric sites out of ~380 on the park map (~20%): mostly seasonal, said in the note. Not iffy: posted 2026 rates, live booking, Google 4.3 (71). Shore row sites C1-C13 and A1-A10 are nightly and lakefront.
flags: WATERFRONT UPGRADE: 'lakeview' -> 'lakefront'. Nightly shore-row sites C1-C13 (C3 is not on Let's Camp) and A1-A10 line the reservoir's west shore around 49.7680,-106.5818. At z18 the shore-row pads are ~20 m from the reed fringe (the reservoir's high-water edge is at or inside it) and ~30-35 m from open water, over open sand and grass. Let's Camp photos of C1, C4 and C11 show open water across open ground past low reeds; C6 and C9 show reeds and willows in front; A1, A5 and A10 show the water through trees. All of these sites are sold nightly on Let's Camp (C1-C30 50 A + water; A1-A2 50 A + water; A3-A13 full service). The stored evidence ('RV loops on upland set back ~200m+') was measured at 49.7695,-106.5735, in the gate and Tuscany loops, which really are set back. PIN MOVE (>250 m): stored 49.77060,-106.57310 is at the front gate / Northern seasonal sites by Hwy 58 -> 49.7683,-106.5808 (centre of the nightly A/C shore loops), ~610 m WSW. The other nightly area, the Tuscany oval (TC51-67 pull-throughs), is at ~49.7694,-106.5734, ~130 m from the stored pin.

NIGHTLY SHARE: Let's Camp sells 89 sites online - 73 electric (A1-A13, B1, B1S, B2, B3, B18-B23, B36, B37, C1-C30 except C3, D12, D13, TC51-TC67) and OVF1-16 unserviced tent pads (10x8 ft). The 2023 campground map shows ~380 sites, the rest seasonal ('All seasonal sites are drawn for at the end of February and beginning of March in a lottery'; 2026 seasonal C$1,765.50-2,117.25 plus power by meter; 'Northern Site Annual Fee: $1600.00'). About 20% nightly: kept at 10-50%, said in the note. The amenities sheet also lists RS1-RS14 (30 A + water) as daily sites, but they are not on Let's Camp.
RIG LENGTH: daily sites run 20-60 ft; most A/C pads are 30-42 ft; TC51-67 are 60-ft pull-throughs. B1S (20 ft), B1 (23 ft) and C17 (24-25 ft) are tight for a 23-ft rig.

SEASON: not posted. The front gate is staffed from May 16 and the office moves to town in September ('Moving in September Location: Town of Lafleche, 42 Main Street. Moving back to park in April'); Let's Camp shows status closed with no open dates now. Nothing written.
